title: Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate for Dogs and Cats, 60cm, Grey
description:
## About the Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate

The Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate is a soft-sided carrier for pet owners who want something sturdier than a simple bag-style carrier but still easy to fold away between trips. A lightweight steel frame keeps its shape while your pet is inside, and the whole crate collapses flat to roughly 60cm x 42cm x 8cm when you are done, so it tucks into a car boot or cupboard without taking up permanent space.

It suits [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) in the 7 to 11kg range, as well as cats who prefer a roomier, more open carrier than a hard box style. Because it opens out into a proper crate shape rather than a narrow bag, pets have enough room to turn around, lie down and settle in for longer journeys.

## Key Features

### Steel Frame with Fold-Flat Design

A metal frame supports the 600D Oxford fabric body, so the crate holds its shape properly while your pet is inside rather than collapsing in on them. Once you are finished, unclip the frame and it folds flat for storage.

### Mesh Doors and Windows

Mesh panels run along the doors and windows, giving your dog or cat a good view out and steady airflow. This also helps nervous pets feel less shut in, since they can see you are close by.

### Storage Pockets

Two side pockets built into the crate hold small items such as a lead, treats or a water bottle, so there is no need to carry a separate bag for short trips.

### Removable Base Mat

A soft, easy-clean mat lines the base for comfort. Lift it out between uses to keep the crate fresh.

## Who This Crate Is Best For

This [dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) and [cat carrier](/carriers/cat-carriers) suits:

- Small to medium dogs weighing roughly 7 to 11kg (Toy Poodles, Corgis, French Bulldogs and similar breeds)
- Cats who prefer more room to move than a hard box-style carrier
- [Car journeys](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) and [vet visits](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers), thanks to the fold-flat storage
- Camping trips, hotel stays or as an occasional indoor den at home
- Owners who want a [soft-sided carrier](/carriers/soft-sided-carriers) that still holds its shape properly

## Care Instructions

Wipe down the fabric exterior with a damp cloth. Lift out the base mat to shake off loose hair and spot clean as needed. Let everything dry fully before folding away, to stop any musty smell developing in storage.

title: Lionto Foldable Dog Crate for Travel and Car, 60cm, Grey
description:
## About the Lionto Foldable Dog Crate

The Lionto Foldable Dog Crate is a fabric and steel-tube crate designed for car travel, house training and everyday resting at home. Oxford fabric stretched over a lightweight steel frame keeps the crate stable while your dog is inside, and it folds down flat when you do not need it, so it does not take up permanent floor space.

A padded reclining cushion with a removable cover lines the base, giving your dog a comfortable spot to settle whether you are on a long drive or they are having a quiet nap at home. Because the crate keeps its shape and has a defined sleeping area, it also works well as part of house training, since most puppies avoid soiling the space they sleep in.

## Key Features

### Steel Tube Frame

Durable, lightweight steel tubes support the fabric body, so the crate holds its shape properly rather than sagging once your dog climbs in.

### Mesh Windows and Zip Access

Mesh netting on the sides and front gives good airflow and lets your dog see out, while zips at the top and front make it easy to get them in and out.

### Padded Cushion Base

A cosy reclining cushion with a removable cover sits inside the base. Take it out to freshen up between uses.

### Fold-Flat Storage

When you do not need the crate, it folds flat for easy storage in a car boot, cupboard or under a bed.

### Carry Handle and Side Pockets

A sturdy carry handle makes it easy to move between the car and the house, and two side pockets hold small items like treats or a lead.

## Who This Crate Is Best For

This [dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) suits:

- Small to medium dogs who need a stable, comfortable crate for car journeys
- Puppies going through house training, thanks to the defined sleeping area
- Owners who want a [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) crate that doubles as an everyday resting spot at home
- Trips to the [vet](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers) or short stays away from home
- Anyone who wants a crate that folds away flat rather than a rigid plastic carrier taking up storage space

## Care Instructions

Remove the cushion cover and wash it separately according to its care label. Wipe the fabric shell with a damp cloth and let everything dry fully before folding the crate away for storage.

title: Conlun Collapsible Soft-Sided Carrier for Cats and Small Dogs, Purple
description:
## About the Conlun Collapsible Carrier

The Conlun Collapsible Carrier is a soft-sided bag-style carrier built for large cats and small to medium dogs up to 10kg. A steel frame inside the polyester body keeps its shape in use, while self-locking zippers mean your pet cannot nudge their way out mid-journey. It is designed for car rides and everyday trips rather than air travel, so it suits owners who need a comfortable, secure carrier for local journeys, vet visits and days out.

It works well as a carrier for larger cat breeds who need a bit more room, and as a small dog carrier for puppies and smaller adult dogs. Always measure your pet's length, height and weight against the carrier's dimensions before buying, to make sure they will be comfortable inside.

## Key Features

### Self-Locking Zippers and Safety Leash

The main zippers lock shut so an inquisitive pet cannot work them open from the inside. An internal safety leash clips onto a harness or collar for extra reassurance during the journey.

### Breathable Mesh on Three Sides

Mesh panels on three sides and an openable top let fresh air in and give your pet a view out, which helps keep them settled rather than feeling shut away.

### External Storage Pockets

Pockets on the outside of the carrier hold small essentials like treats, a lead or waste bags, so you do not need to carry a separate bag for short trips.

### Removable, Washable Base Mat

A soft fleece mat lines the base for comfort and lifts out for hand or machine washing.

### Padded Strap and Carry Handles

Carry it by the top handles or use the adjustable, padded shoulder strap for hands-free trips.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

- Large cat breeds who need more room than a standard cat carrier
- Small to medium dogs and puppies up to around 10kg
- Car journeys and vet visits
- Owners who want a soft-sided carrier that still holds its shape
- Everyday errands where a lightweight, foldable carrier is easier to store between trips

This carrier is not certified for air travel, so it is best kept for car journeys and everyday outings rather than flights.

## Care Instructions

Wipe the polyester exterior down with a damp cloth. Remove the fleece base mat to hand wash or machine wash on a gentle cycle, and let it dry fully before folding the carrier away for storage.

title: DPWEION Foldable Soft-Sided Pet Carrier for Cats and Small Dogs, Grey
description:
## About the DPWEION Foldable Pet Carrier

The DPWEION carrier is a soft-sided, foldable travel bag built for [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) and cats who need a comfortable, secure way to get from A to B. A steel frame and wooden support board keep the bag's shape steady rather than collapsing in on your pet, while mesh panels on all four sides let air circulate and give your pet a clear view out.

It suits pets up to around 7.3kg (16lbs), though as with any carrier it is worth checking your pet's length and height as well as their weight before choosing a size. The [soft-sided](/carriers/soft-sided-carriers) design folds flat for storage between trips, and a front pocket keeps small essentials like treats or a lead close to hand.

## Key Features

### Steel Frame with Four-Sided Mesh

A sturdy steel frame and wooden support board hold the carrier's shape, so it does not sag or wobble when your pet moves around inside. Mesh windows on all four sides keep air moving and let your pet see their surroundings, which can help them feel less closed in during the journey.

### Airline-Sized and Car Ready

The carrier is sized to fit under most aeroplane seats and includes four non-slip feet to help stop it sliding around in a car or on a bus seat. It can also be fastened using a [car seatbelt](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) or the adjustable shoulder strap, giving you a couple of ways to keep it steady on the move.

### Removable, Washable Pad

The soft pad inside lifts out for washing, and the outer fabric wipes clean with a damp cloth, so everyday muck from paws or accidents is easy to deal with.

### Folds Flat with a Front Pocket

When it is not in use, the carrier folds down flat to save space in a cupboard or car boot. A front pocket gives you somewhere to keep small items like treats, poo bags or a spare lead.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier suits:

- Small dogs and cats up to around 7.3kg (16lbs)
- Owners taking car journeys who want a carrier that can be belted in securely
- [Cat owners](/carriers/cat-carriers) who want a soft, foldable option rather than a rigid box carrier
- Nervous pets who benefit from mesh windows on every side for airflow and visibility
- Anyone who wants a carrier that folds away flat between trips

## Care Instructions

Remove the internal pad and wash it according to the care label, then leave it to dry fully before putting it back in the carrier. Wipe the outer fabric down with a damp cloth for everyday marks, and let the whole carrier air dry before folding it away, to avoid a musty smell building up in storage.

title: Pecute Extra Large Cat and Dog Carrier with Panoramic Windows, Green
description:
## About the Pecute Extra Large Carrier

This Pecute carrier is a spacious, soft-sided travel bag built around a 5mm high-tensile steel wire frame, giving it a dome shape that holds firm rather than collapsing under pressure. It is around 3cm wider on each side than a standard [carrier](/carriers), so there is genuinely more room inside for a [large cat](/carriers/cat-carriers/large-cat-carriers) or a small dog to sit and turn around.

Three-sided double-layer mesh windows keep air moving and are scratch resistant, while a pair of clear panoramic windows let your pet see out. An automatic safety lock zip, which can only be opened from the outside, and an adjustable internal safety leash are both included to reduce the risk of a nervous pet pushing their way out mid-journey.

## Key Features

### Reinforced Steel Wire Frame

A 5mm high-tensile steel wire frame keeps the carrier's dome shape rigid, so it stays stable and impact resistant rather than flexing under your pet's weight or an accidental knock.

### Breathable Mesh on Three Sides

Double-layer nylon mesh windows on three sides boost airflow and help stop the inside of the carrier overheating, while the scratch-resistant weave stands up to claws better than a standard single-layer mesh.

### Double Escape-Proof System

An automatic safety lock zip that only opens from the outside, combined with an adjustable internal safety leash, gives you two layers of protection against an anxious pet working a zip open in a busy public space.

### Secure Car Fitting

A detachable wide shoulder strap and carry handle make it easy to switch how you carry it, and it locks onto a car seatbelt so it will not slide around under sudden braking.

### Washable Mat and Storage Pockets

A machine-washable plush mat lines the base for comfort, and side storage pockets give you somewhere to keep a lead, treats or waste bags without needing a separate bag.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier suits:

- Large cats and small to medium dogs who need extra room to turn around
- Owners who want the reassurance of a double escape-proof zip and leash system
- [Hiking](/carriers/hiking-pet-carriers), walking and day trips, thanks to the breathable mesh and panoramic windows
- Car journeys, with a strap that locks onto a standard seatbelt
- Pets who feel calmer being able to see out through clear windows rather than being fully enclosed

## Care Instructions

title: PAWPUBBY Hands-Free Padded Dog Sling Carrier, Caramel
description:
## About the PAWPUBBY Dog Sling Carrier

The PAWPUBBY sling is a hands-free [dog sling](/carriers/dog-carriers/dog-slings) carrier for small dogs and kittens who feel safest held close against you. An ergonomic, body-contoured shape spreads your pet's weight across your shoulder rather than your hand or arm, which makes it a comfortable option for longer outings such as shopping trips or [everyday walks](/carriers/everyday-carriers).

A breathable cotton-poly blend keeps things comfortable for both of you in most weather, and an integrated safety tether clips to your pet's collar for extra reassurance. It suits [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) and kittens who prefer to be carried close rather than zipped into an enclosed carrier.

## Key Features

### Ergonomic, Weight-Distributing Shape

The sling contours to your body and spreads your pet's weight across your shoulder, which is more comfortable over time than carrying them in one hand or a basic bag-style sling.

### Padded, Breathable Strap

An extra-wide, padded shoulder strap made from a breathable cotton-poly blend reduces shoulder pressure and stays comfortable across the seasons.

### Integrated Safety Tether

A built-in safety lead clips to your pet's collar, and a reinforced anti-escape buckle adds a second layer of security, so a wriggle or sudden movement is less likely to end in an escape.

### Buckle and Velcro Dual Adjustment

A quick-release buckle combined with a hook-and-loop strap lets you fine-tune the fit in seconds and keeps it secure once set.

### Built-In Storage Pocket

A pocket on the shoulder strap holds a phone, keys or treats, so you do not need to carry a separate bag on short trips.

## Who This Sling Is Best For

This sling suits:

- Small dogs and kittens who prefer to be held close rather than enclosed
- Owners wanting a hands-free option for shopping trips and daily walks
- Nervous pets who settle better with a safety tether attached to their collar
- Anyone who wants a padded strap for longer periods of carrying

title: Amazon Basics Soft Cat and Dog Carrier, Airline Approved, Grey
description:
## About the Amazon Basics Soft Cat and Dog Carrier

This is a lightweight, tote-style [soft sided](/carriers/soft-sided-carriers) carrier built for short trips with a small pet, whether that's a quick dash to the [vet visit](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers) or a longer day of [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers). At roughly 43cm x 28cm x 28cm, it suits [small dog](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) breeds and most cats comfortably, giving them enough room to turn around and settle without the carrier feeling bulky to carry.

What sets it apart is how easily it packs away. The frame folds completely flat when not in use, so it tucks under a car seat or into a cupboard between trips. Mesh panels on the top and sides keep air moving and let your pet see out, while two connecting loop handles double up as a makeshift seatbelt anchor or luggage strap for the car or the airport. It's an Amazon Basics product, so build quality and stitching are consistent with what you'd expect from that range.

## Key Features and Benefits

### Airline-Approved, Foldable Design
The carrier is built to the compact dimensions airlines generally ask for in cabin pet carriers, and it folds flat to a slim pad when empty. That makes it easy to bring along on a flight, then store away at home without it taking up a cupboard shelf.

### Mesh Ventilation All Round
Breathable mesh panels run along the top and sides, keeping air flowing so your pet doesn't overheat on a warm day or a longer journey. The mesh also means your pet can see you and their surroundings, which tends to keep them calmer than a fully enclosed box.

### Adjustable Shoulder Strap and Loop Handles
An adjustable shoulder strap lets you carry the bag hands-free at a comfortable height, while the two connecting loop handles give you a second way to lift it or to loop it through a car seatbelt for extra stability on the move.

### Top and Side Entry with Secure Zips
Two entry points, one on top and one on the side, make it easier to lower a nervous pet in gently rather than posting them through a single small opening. Both openings close with a reliable zip, so your pet stays secure once they're in.

### Washable Cushion Cover
A soft cushion lines the base of the carrier, and the cover comes off for washing. That's a genuinely useful detail after a car-sick cat or a muddy paw, since you can freshen the whole thing up without having to hand-wash the entire bag.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier suits owners who need something light, foldable and easy to store between occasional trips, rather than a rigid everyday carrier. It works well for:

- Small dogs and cats making short [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) journeys
- Nervous pets who do better seeing out through mesh than being fully enclosed
- Owners who want a carrier that folds flat for storage in a flat or small car boot
- [Vet visit](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers) trips where you need something quick to grab and quick to put away again

If you have a larger dog, a [medium dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers/medium-dog-carriers) or a sturdier structured carrier will give them more room to move.

## Care Instructions

Wipe down the outer fabric with a damp cloth and a little mild soap if it picks up dirt or fur. The cushion cover unzips from the base pad, so remove it for a hand wash or a gentle machine wash on a cool cycle, then leave it to air dry fully before putting it back in the carrier. Avoid tumble drying the cushion cover, as high heat can affect the padding. Once dry, the whole carrier folds flat for storage, so keep it somewhere it won't get crushed under anything heavy.

A support board built into the base stops the bag from collapsing in on itself, so your pet has a stable, flat floor to stand or lie on rather than a floppy fabric hammock. The top opening makes it easier to lower your pet in gently.

Mesh panels across the top and sides keep air moving and give your pet a clear view of their surroundings. Good airflow matters most on warmer days or longer journeys, and being able to see out tends to keep pets calmer than travelling in the dark.

A 5mm steel wire frame runs through the structure, reinforced with four fixing buckles and a honeycomb board base, so the carrier keeps its shape even on a bumpy [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) journey.

What makes this carrier different is the two-zone layout inside. One area is made from breathable, scratch-resistant mesh so your cat can see out and get plenty of airflow, while the other is a partially enclosed, more private zone. That gives a nervous cat somewhere quieter to settle if they'd rather not be fully on view, without losing the ventilation of the open section. It works well for [everyday](/carriers/everyday-carriers) trips as well as occasional [vet visit](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers) journeys.

## Key Features and Benefits

### Reinforced Steel Frame Structure
A 5mm steel wire frame, four fixing buckles and an integrated honeycomb board keep the carrier rigid and stable, so it won't collapse or lose its shape when your cat moves around inside, even over an uneven road surface.

### Dual Car Safety Fixing
The carrier can be secured in the car using either a seatbelt or the shoulder strap, giving your cat a steadier, more secure position on the seat rather than sliding around during the drive.

### Lockable Zips and an Internal Safety Strap
Both entry points use lockable zips, and there's an adjustable safety strap inside that clips to your cat's harness or collar, giving you two separate ways to stop them slipping out unexpectedly.

### Two-Zone Layout for Choice
A breathable mesh zone gives your cat a view out and good airflow, while a more enclosed zone gives them somewhere quieter to settle if they'd rather not be on show. Letting your cat choose between the two can make the carrier feel less overwhelming on a journey.

### Compact, Travel-Friendly Size
At roughly 43cm x 28cm x 28cm, it's a manageable size for carrying and for fitting into a car footwell or under a seat, without being so small that a kitten or slim cat feels cramped.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier is designed specifically around smaller cats rather than being a generic multi-pet carrier. It suits:

- [Kittens](/carriers/cat-carriers/kitten-carriers) and slimmer adult cats under approximately 5kg
- Cats who tend to be nervous and benefit from a quieter, partially enclosed space to retreat to
- Regular [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) where secure fixing matters
- Owners who want a sturdier, frame-supported carrier rather than a soft floppy bag

For a larger or heavier cat, look at a [large cat carrier](/carriers/cat-carriers/large-cat-carriers) instead, which will give them more room to turn around.

## Care Instructions

Wipe the outer mesh and fabric panels with a damp cloth to remove everyday dirt and fur. Check the zips periodically to make sure they're running smoothly and lock properly before each trip. The frame and honeycomb board shouldn't be submerged in water, so stick to spot cleaning rather than a full wash, and let the carrier air dry fully before folding it away.

title: Drawstring Head-Out Dog Backpack Carrier, Ventilated
description:
## About the Drawstring Head-Out Dog Backpack Carrier

This is a front-worn [dog backpack carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers/dog-backpack-carriers) with a drawstring opening that lets your dog's head and front legs stay out, so they can drape their legs over your shoulder or arm and stay close to you rather than sitting fully enclosed. It's aimed at [small dog](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) breeds and [puppies](/carriers/dog-carriers/puppy-carriers), suiting breeds like Chihuahuas, Yorkies, Maltese, Shih Tzus, Pugs and similarly sized dogs who are happiest kept close on a walk.

Unlike a fully sealed backpack with a single small viewing window, the mesh sides here give proper airflow on all sides, so your dog can see out and breathe easily rather than peering through one small gap. An inner safety hook clips to your dog's collar, giving you a second layer of security alongside the drawstring opening itself, so they can't easily climb or jump out mid-walk.

## Key Features and Benefits

### Head-Out, Legs-Out Design
The drawstring opening lets your dog's head and front legs stay free, so they can rest their legs over your shoulder or the top of the bag rather than being fully tucked away. Many dogs settle better when they can still see and feel close contact with you.

### Mesh Sides for Airflow and Visibility
Rather than one small window, mesh panels run along the sides of the bag, giving a much wider field of view and better airflow, which matters on longer walks or warmer days.

### Elastic and Buckle-Lock Opening
The opening adjusts with an elastic band and a buckle-lock, so you can fit the bag to your dog's size and keep it secure rather than leaving a loose gap they could wriggle out of.

### Padded, Adjustable Carrying Straps
A padded, breathable shoulder strap works alongside adjustable chest and waist straps to spread your dog's weight more evenly, which is noticeably more comfortable than a single thin strap on a longer walk.

### Three Storage Pockets
Three separate pockets give you somewhere to keep water, treats, poo bags and other essentials, so you don't need to carry a second bag on a typical walk or day out.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This backpack suits owners who want to keep a small dog close and hands-free rather than carrying them or using a lead the whole way. It's a good fit for:

- [Small dog](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) breeds and [puppies](/carriers/dog-carriers/puppy-carriers) who prefer to stay close to their owner
- Dogs who get tired mid-walk but still want to see and feel involved
- Everyday walks, the vet, public transport, or busy places like shops and markets
- Owners who want a hands-free option with storage for essentials built in

Always measure your dog and check the fit before your first outing, since the listing covers a size range from around 1kg up to 25kg for small to medium dogs.

## Care Instructions

Wipe down the outer fabric with a damp cloth for everyday dirt and spot-clean stains as they happen. The waterproof lining helps protect the bag itself if your dog is wet or muddy after a walk, but avoid fully submerging the bag or machine washing it, as this can affect the padding and straps. Let it air dry fully before folding it away.
